mechanism_of_action: Agonist of the glucose-dependent insulinotropic polypeptide and glucagon-like peptide-1 receptors.
primary_endpoint: Resolution of MASH without worsening of fibrosis at 52 weeks.
efficacy_outcome: Resolution occurred in 10% with placebo versus 44%, 56%, and 62% with tirzepatide 5, 10, and 15 mg, respectively (all comparisons P<0.001).
